materials_exhausted.note: XML tables/results, PDF text, OA package, supplementary ZIP PDFs, landing supplement HTML wrappers, and linked database snapshots were checked for the worker-4/worker-6 blockers.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: LHH1 identity, sequence, precursor location, most MIC/MBC/IC50 rows, citation, and DRAMP identity are source-supported. Target-label differences and exact database-only figure percentages are preserved as source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final LHH1 rows retain only source-supported Table 3 MIC/MBC, Table 5 IC50, HC50 text, and qualitative RAW264.7 low-toxicity evidence; comparator columns and unsupported exact figure-derived database values are not promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 replaced placeholder mechanism notes with source-located membrane damage/permeabilization and cancer-cell membrane/apoptosis claims, bounded to direct assay types actually present in the paper.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_materials: The supplementary ZIP contains HPLC/MS/FITC-labeling PDFs for peptide characterization; pdftotext found no supplementary activity/toxicity/mechanism tables that change the final rows.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Rows whose database target labels differ from the paper table labels are preserved as source_conflict in the database layer rather than silently normalized.
Exact hemolysis/RAW264.7 percentage bands present in database snapshots are not promoted as primary-source verified unless the XML/PDF text states the value; they remain source_conflict cautions.
Primary material verifies synthetic LHH1 identity/purity/mass but does not explicitly state unlabeled LHH1 N- or C-terminal blocking; no terminal modification was fabricated.

adjudication_summary: Source re-review completed for LHH1: the primary XML/PDF supports the LHH1 sequence, table activity values, tumor-cell IC50 values, HC50 text, and membrane/cancer-cell mechanism claims. Remaining database disagreements are explicit cautions rather than open blockers.
